question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f200f7686f1fbeffbcae16ebdf1e290314555b1a71b46a24305652963311f92f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is,

Logic: The triangle rotates by 45° in the anticlockwise direction,

The letter is increased by one place value in English alphabetical order.

A new sign comes inside the triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/882373f93aa768dcccb164c9380eb664b54ac1135fc5d30dac2a12f085fc97d3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
